title: Minimum Jumps to Reach Home (Forward/Backward)

monster.name: Bounder Goblin
monster.title: Skipper of Forbidden Trapdoors
monster.defeatQuote: Shortest jump sequence to target location x without double back-jumps!

description: A certain bug's home is at position `x` on the number line. It starts at position 0. It can jump forward `a` steps or backward `b` steps. It cannot jump backward twice in a row. It cannot visit positions in `forbidden` or negative positions. Return the minimum number of jumps needed to reach `x`, or -1 if impossible.
starterCode:
def minimumJumps(forbidden: list[int], a: int, b: int, x: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def minimumJumps(forbidden: list[int], a: int, b: int, x: int) -> int:
    from collections import deque
    forbid = set(forbidden)
    limit = 6000
    q = deque([(0, 0, False)])  # (pos, steps, just_backed)
    visited = {(0, False)}
    while q:
        pos, steps, backed = q.popleft()
        if pos == x: return steps
        # Jump forward
        nxt_f = pos + a
        if nxt_f <= limit and nxt_f not in forbid and (nxt_f, False) not in visited:
            visited.add((nxt_f, False))
            q.append((nxt_f, steps + 1, False))
        # Jump backward
        if not backed:
            nxt_b = pos - b
            if nxt_b >= 0 and nxt_b not in forbid and (nxt_b, True) not in visited:
                visited.add((nxt_b, True))
                q.append((nxt_b, steps + 1, True))
    return -1
hints: BFS state is (position, did_jump_back_just_now). Upper bound is max(x, max(forbidden)) + a + b.
